text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, take care of yourself!
Come back if you ever find yourself struggling again, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yes, next person, please.

Today is Valentine's Day.
Yet for some reason, Mejiro Palmer was as busy as a doctor making house calls.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um... Palmer. Can I get some advice?
Lately, I've been feeling kind of...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My urge to give chocolate to Ikuno-san
is growing stronger. Do you think it would
be alright to give it to her?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
McQueen...
I see, Ikuno Dictus, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Ikuno...
Some call her straight-laced and an 'Iron Woman',
but...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(She's not really a cold girl at all.
She actually understands how people feel, y'know?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, why not try giving it to them?
I'm sure they'll be happy, and besides...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You never know if your own vibes are the real deal unless you try all sorts of things out, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Try out various things...
...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you truly are dependable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Phew, my shoulders are so stiff~.
Talking to that many people will do that to ya♪
choice_data_list: What were you doing in the classroom?
What were you doing in the classroom?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, like Valentine's advice?
People are always asking me for that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "People always open up to me around this time. And when someone relies on you, you just wanna help them out, right?"

—A trusted confidante.
It seems that is the role Mejiro Palmer
holds at the academy.

"Offering advice is certainly a good thing,
but what worries me is the other side of it..."
choice_data_list: Don't you have any worries of your own, Palmer?
Don't you have any worries of your own, Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Me? I tend to work things out on my own.
Especially the small worries.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, but... was there one thing I was still on the fence about?
choice_data_list: If you have an idea, I'd like to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Trainer?
You'll be my listener?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see. It's a bit complicated, but...
if you say so, maybe I'll try talking to them.
Mejiro Palmer broached the subject timidly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You know, there's someone I want to give chocolate to.
But, how should I put it, if I actually do...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Our relationship, or like, our distance? Our vibe?
I felt like that might all end up changing, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Would it be... okay if I gave it to them?
If I just hand it over casually, that is.
choice_data_list: I think I'll be fine, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"She was actually conscious of that?" Won't people think
something like that? Won't things stay the same as always?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Definitely?! Really?!
Absolute, absolute, absolutely?!
choice_data_list: I-I don't know that much, but calm down.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry... I just got a little carried away.
I really didn't want our relationship to be ruined.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Still, if Trainer says so,
then I guess it'll be all right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Um... here.
With that said, Mejiro Palmer produced a wrapped package from behind her back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It'll be okay... right?
They said nothing would change, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So you're sayin' you wanna give it to 'em and have 'em eat it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Normally I'd have wanted to go all out with a hyped-up
'Woohoo, Valentine's!☆' vibe, but honestly, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Sorry, I chickened out...
Will you take this?
I gratefully accept the chocolates. They were wrapped with exquisite care.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You know. I don't really ask for much.
But when a little worry pops up like right now—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind giving me some quick advice?
There aren't many people I can talk to about
sensitive things like this, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see, I see.
Ahaha... That's a relief~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, my hands are totally sweaty!
I think I was more nervous than I've been all year.
Valentine's is seriously crazy, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She smiled, giving a shrug.
It seemed I had managed to provide
an outlet for Mejiro Palmer's feelings.

She smiled, giving a shrug.
It seemed I had managed to provide
an outlet for Mejiro Palmer's feelings.
It happened on the way back—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey. While I'm at it with giving you chocolates,
on the way home today, um...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm not asking for much, really!?
Just if you wouldn't mind...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Mejiro Palmer!
Hey, rumor has it she gives love advice!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Really? Do you think we fans
might have a shot at getting noticed too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, like, it's spread outside the academy too?
Well, if it's just about two people...
(Rumble rumble rumble!)

text_block_list.name: Horde of Fans
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH, Palmer!!!
Listen to me, Palmer!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh, wait, what!?
There's no way I can do all this~!!
Valentine's Day is gonna end~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh!? When you say run away...

Leading the hesitating Mejiro Palmer,
we made a full-sprint escape!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, ugh, so tired...
Maybe I ran a bit too hard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer, look, look at the view!
Whoa, it's so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Seems I stumbled into an awesome escape spot by chance. Twilight is the abso-lute best! Woohoo~!!
As she said that, looking out at the sunset, Mejiro Palmer seemed genuinely happy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
Being surrounded by lots of people is nice and all, but what if there's just way too many?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Maybe running away together wouldn't be so bad, just the two of us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, anywhere!
Destination doesn't matter!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it'd be nice to just travel and live freely.
If I ever truly get the chance
to live however I want, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine with that.
As long as there's someone willing to hear me out, that's enough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
This is, um, whatcha call it. A Valentine's message
from me. Just kidding...

A mild evening breeze blew past,
swaying Mejiro Palmer's loose strands of hair.
